flags: "No Name" is Q's coded reference to John McCain per archive convention; the image itself does not name him

description: Screenshot of Q post #2066 (board post No.2863057, ID a68ba4, Sep 3 2018). The post embeds bracketed letter-number pairs in its words ([C-3], [A-5], [S-6], [D-1], [E-2], [L-4]); ordered by number they spell "DECLAS", a Q code for declassification. The post says both chambers of Congress are in session tomorrow. Original filename was FISA[20].jpg.
text: Q !!mG7VJxZNCI ID: a68ba4 No.2863057. 2066. Sep 3 2018 17:29:27 (EST). Both [C-3]h[A-5]mbers (House / Senate) in [S-6]ESSION tomorrow. Where once there was [D-1]ARK. Th[E-2]re is now [L-4]IGHT. Q
flags: The DECLAS decoding is the standard reading of the bracket code, not stated explicitly in the image

description: Screenshot of a Drudge Report headline reading "TWITTER BLOCKS JONES PERMANENTLY", reporting Twitter's permanent ban of Alex Jones (September 2018). The photo shows a crowded scene outside a Capitol Hill hearing: a uniformed Capitol Police officer escorts Twitter CEO Jack Dorsey through a press scrum, with a man consistent with Alex Jones confronting the group at right.
text: TWITTER BLOCKS JONES PERMANENTLY. DRUDGE REPORT
flags: Photo identifications of Dorsey and Jones are consistent with the widely photographed Sep 5 2018 Capitol Hill confrontation but not captioned in the image

description: Scanned captioned group photograph headed "MEETING IN KRAKOW, POLAND / MARCH 6, 1995". Nine people in winter coats pose outside the arched entrance of the Wierzynek restaurant (est. 1364) in Krakow. The caption identifies the group left to right as a translator, Dariusz Szpoper, Dr. Jerry Corsi (Jerome Corsi), Miroslaw Styczen, John Gruber, Dr. Glenn Olds, Jaroslaw Pyszczuk, Mel Rockefeller and Brad Amundson.
text: MEETING IN KRAKOW, POLAND. MARCH 6, 1995. Wierzynek. 1364. Pictured from left to right: translator, Dariusz Szpoper, Dr. Jerry Corsi, Miroslaw Styczen, John Gruber, Dr. Glenn Olds, Jaroslaw Pyszczuk, Mel Rockefeller and Brad Amundson.
flags: Identifications rest entirely on the printed caption; individual faces not independently verified
Several caption-named individuals appear to be private persons
